blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these equations have no solution? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Select all the equations that have no solution.

blocks.text: Three x plus seven equals three x minus two. Subtract three x: seven equals negative two. False, so no solution.
Two times the quantity x plus five is two x plus ten, exactly the right side. Always true, so infinitely many solutions, not none.
Five x minus one equals four x minus one. The x coefficients are different, five and four, so there is one solution, x equals zero.
Distribute: four x minus four equals four x plus three. Subtract four x: negative four equals three. False, so no solution.
x plus six equals two x plus six. The coefficients are different, one and two, so there is one solution, x equals zero. Matching constants don't change that.

Distribute and combine on the left: eight x minus three x minus three is five x minus three. So five x minus three equals five x plus one. The x terms cancel and negative three equals one is false. No solution.

Three equations have no solution: three x plus seven equals three x minus two, four times the quantity x minus one equals four x plus three, and eight x minus three times the quantity x plus one equals five x plus one. In each one the x terms cancel and a false statement is left.
